test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: P is the father of E. E is the sister of A. A has only one brother L. T is the only grandson of P. M is the wife of A. Only one child of P is married. How is L related to T?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/157d2ec770237097989beb9a00ef41711bba34c2aea64333d8b7821f025c749e.png] 

According to given conditions,

1) P is the father of E.

2) E is the sister of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c41b26fa50f6893fbbaca001ea050399e9a406fd2e3a237ec703fc39135ee86f.png] 

3) M is the wife of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2969d21e5821ced377525c0c11db4e7084ade9ffa36a9d81f372635a9540c5f0.png] 

4) A has only one brother L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af3ee35d2d382449849d936a61fefb1ec4df84eb99bd115dcbaabbea863f6258.png] 

5) T is the only grandson of P.

6) Only one child of P is married.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4781c195239047fcf81404d46fd2e5c5898aa23519d60e959853b7261341000b.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree L is the paternal uncle i.e father's brother of T.

Hence, "**Father's brother**" is the correct answer.
